sources.title: GENIUS Olympiad Ukraine — home and season announcement

sources.title: GENIUS Olympiad Ukraine — categories, AI section
sources.supports: Published national AI report/video requirements and assessment headings.
sources.caveat: Working baseline: page still contains a 2026 final reference; recheck 2027.

sources.title: GENIUS Olympiad Ukraine — participants
sources.supports: Ukrainian-school/age eligibility, language and registration routes.
sources.caveat: Residence abroad does not by itself establish or disprove school eligibility.

sources.title: GENIUS Olympiad — disciplines, AI section
sources.supports: AI: English report, video, final presentation, meaningful student work, rubric.
sources.caveat: Do not import adjacent Coding hackathon or Speech topic requirements.

sources.title: GENIUS AI Research Paper template
sources.supports: Six-page template; formatting, sections, abstract, student roles and external contributions.
sources.caveat: Re-download before final build; count total international pages including references.

sources.title: Introducing OpenTextile-NIR — article and data description
sources.supports: 71 physical samples, millions of spectra, supplier composition information, mean spectra and file types; April 2026 article.
sources.caveat: Article DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2026.112559. Data files and data license not inspected here. Description uses both post-industrial and end-of-life terminology; verify provenance.

sources.title: Tuomas Sormunen — creator research and dataset record
sources.supports: Creator record identifies OpenTextile-NIR dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18269172, January 2026.
sources.caveat: This verifies a locator, not data contents or a license.

sources.title: OpenTextile-NIR — dataset DOI/Zenodo landing
sources.supports: Candidate raw-data source; resolve metadata, mean spectra, manifest and license first.
sources.caveat: Zenodo direct record/API could not be opened in this research session. Runtime access is an explicit gate, not an assumed success.

sources.title: JRC141441 report — textile recyclability and feedstock requirements
sources.supports: Table 5, printed page26 / physical PDF page30, contains process-specific fibre thresholds based on WRAP information.
sources.caveat: Table is a 2024 snapshot, not a universal current industrial standard. Other requirements also apply. Includes >=95% polyester among several profiles.

sources.title: Feedstock Activation Europe case study
sources.supports: Heterogeneous post-consumer feedstock and recycler specifications; examples of composition-based sorting.
sources.caveat: Industrial need evidence; not evidence of our algorithm or environmental savings.

sources.title: T-REX project reporting
sources.supports: Textile-to-textile value chain, quality feedstock and sorting challenges.
sources.caveat: Use exact reporting period and verified text for quantitative claims.

sources.title: Automatisierte Textilsortierung — Status quo, Herausforderungen und Perspektiven
sources.supports: Existing automated textile sorting, composition, contaminants and limitations.
sources.caveat: Prior art seed; not a completed survey of selective routing.

sources.title: scikit-learn — cross decomposition
sources.supports: PLS and related low-compute candidate baselines.
sources.caveat: Candidate, not a predetermined best algorithm. Check pinned version APIs.

sources.title: scikit-learn — cross-validation
sources.supports: Grouped splitting and evaluation methods.
sources.caveat: An API choice does not prove this dataset satisfies independence assumptions.

sources.title: Learn then Test: Calibrating Predictive Algorithms to Achieve Risk Control
sources.supports: Existing statistical risk-control framework and assumptions.
sources.caveat: Read full methods before implementation; not an automatic industrial risk guarantee.

sources.title: Conformal Risk Control
sources.supports: Existing conformal risk methodology.
sources.caveat: Clarify the exact risk and expectation/probability statement; not interchangeable with accepted-set precision.

sources.title: Conformalized Quantile Regression
sources.supports: Candidate prediction-interval approach.
sources.caveat: Marginal interval coverage is not selective precision or batch purity.

sources.title: MAPIE — official documentation
sources.supports: Current uncertainty, calibration and risk-control tools.
sources.caveat: Version-specific API; toolkit use alone is not a contribution.

sources.title: MAPIE — precision control for a binary classifier
sources.supports: Direct existing comparator for a selective eligibility system.
sources.caveat: Follow statistical assumptions and data-split requirements; apply only if data supports it.

sources.title: Codex / ChatGPT models
sources.supports: Model IDs gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-6-astra; availability must be checked locally.
sources.caveat: Plan/client/account may differ; explicit effort values still require local verification.

sources.title: Codex — subagents
sources.supports: Project agent TOML format, model/effort override, concurrency and inherited approvals.
sources.caveat: Configuration format can evolve. Native available tooling, not fictitious tool calls, is authoritative.

sources.title: Codex — AGENTS.md
sources.supports: Path-scoped instructions and bounded instruction context.
sources.caveat: Keep root concise and do not overwrite pre-existing/global instructions.

sources.title: Codex — non-interactive mode
sources.supports: codex exec, output artifacts, scriptable sessions and failure handling.
sources.caveat: Runner flags must be checked with installed --help; no permission bypass.

sources.title: Codex — git worktrees
sources.supports: Isolated changes and integration workflow.
sources.caveat: Worktrees are optional for a small local project; one writer per file still matters.

sources.title: Codex ExecPlans for long-running tasks
sources.supports: Living self-contained plans, milestones and validation.
sources.caveat: Adapt the pattern; do not copy unnecessary long templates into every agent context.

sources.title: Effective harnesses for long-running agents
sources.supports: Initializer plus incremental sessions, persistent progress, explicit tests and end-to-end checks.
sources.caveat: Practice report, not a guarantee of elapsed time or research correctness.

sources.title: How we built our multi-agent research system
sources.supports: Bounded delegation, tool use, evaluation and context tradeoffs.
sources.caveat: Different product/workload; borrow principles, not performance estimates.
